label: Facade
description: Facade materials and building skins as hero close-ups.

items.name: corten-skin
items.text: a weathering-steel facade rusted to velvet orange, laser-cut perforations glowing from the lit interior behind

items.name: curtain-wall
items.text: a glass curtain wall reflecting sliding clouds, the mullion grid imposing its rhythm on the sky

items.name: timber-slats
items.text: a screen of vertical larch slats silvering unevenly with weather, interior light striping out through the gaps

items.name: copper-patina
items.text: a copper-shingled facade caught mid-patina, bright penny fading through umber into streaks of malachite green

items.name: azulejo-tiles
items.text: a townhouse front tiled edge to edge in blue-and-white azulejo, glaze crazed and chipped around the window reveals

items.name: gabion-stone
items.text: a gabion facade of wire cages packed tight with river stone, texture shifting grey to russet bay by bay

items.name: mashrabiya-screen
items.text: a carved timber mashrabiya screen, star-and-polygon lattice throwing patterned light deep into the room behind

items.name: mirror-cladding
items.text: a mirror-clad volume dissolving into its own reflection of hills and sky, seams betraying the illusion only at the corners

items.name: clinker-brick
items.text: hand-laid clinker brick in Flemish bond, over-fired headers glinting purple-black among the reds

items.name: living-wall
items.text: a living green wall shingled in overlapping fern and moss panels, drip lines glistening in the shade

items.name: terracotta-louvres
items.text: a sunscreen of terracotta baguette louvres, warm ochre bars stacking parallel shadows onto the glass behind

items.name: rammed-earth
items.text: a rammed-earth wall banded in strata of ochre, rose and umber, every formwork lift line reading like sediment

items.name: shou-sugi-ban
items.text: a charred shou-sugi-ban cedar facade, alligator-cracked black boards with a soft graphite sheen, the grain reading silver wherever light rakes across it

items.name: etfe-pillows
items.text: an ETFE cushion facade, quilted translucent pillows bulging from a steel diagrid, frit dot-shading printed denser toward the sun side

items.name: glass-block-wall
items.text: a wall of glass block glowing like packed ice, each prism bending its own soft square of light, the joints reading as a dark grid through the glow

items.name: sgraffito-plaster
items.text: a sgraffito facade, allegorical figures scratched through white lime plaster to the grey coat beneath, ornament still crisp in the reveals and worn soft on the weather side

items.name: fluted-precast
items.text: fluted precast concrete panels, vertical ribs flipping from ivory to deep shadow as the sun moves off axis, panel joints aligned exactly to the flute rhythm
